main_text.p: des transferte, dummodò non intra ostuagesimum à mari stadium: nam Carthaginem hanc delere, nobis est constitutum. Tum verò dolor ingens legatis in amentiam primum mutatus, & voces atroces jactatæ. Mox maxstum filentium secutum, & post id lamenta, querelæ, preces, datæ fidei obtestatio, perfidiæ detestatio. Et cum proficeretur nihil, legati in urbem reversi, expositis omnibus in furorem pene eam dederunt. Sævitum verbis in primores, qui priora suaserant, & post obsides datos armis omnibus civitatem nudaverant. Audita vifaque omnia, quæ tali sui inopinato & indigno erant consilia. Kursum legati ad consules missi, breves inducias petitæ, per quas suspicatum iri Romam posset. Quod cum frustrà esset, tandem ex desperatione in rabiem acta civitas, iniquissimæ vis ac injuriæ propulsatio decreta, Asdrubal exul, qui contra patriam exercitum paratum habebat, revocatus, patriæque reconciliatus. Tum hostilia utrimque accepta: in quibus apparuit, desperata pervicacia quid posset, & robur Carthaginis etiam inermis quantum esset. Bellum enim in quartum annum tractum, multa ab obsessis oppugnatisque patrata, quæ fidem pene superant.

page.notes: Left margin: faint marks (v, to, A, and small symbols) are show-through from the reverse side and were left out. Printed text reads "est constitutum" and "Mox maxstum" as set; "maxstum" may be a printing error for "maximum" and is left as printed. The line "ia. Kursum" / "consilia" was joined across the line break at "con-". Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
